_comment: Why is Flint 1k/2k prefill ~40% slower on DevLab than on the dev machine (same package, SDK, llama.cpp, GGUF) while llama.cpp is faster there and dense cards match? Hypotheses: (1) CPU power policy (dev machine: power-profiles-daemon performance, governor/EPP performance) slows Loom's many MoE expert-bucket launches; (2) GPU-addressable memory (Flint has the largest budget, 67 GB). Each Flint variant: settings, Loom at 67/45 GB, llama.cpp, then the performance profile and Loom again on the same runner. Glimmer (dense, matches today) is the control.
